summary: V3 fixes the contradictions that broke the payoff in V2. There is one finish now: S094 stops about 85 px short of the flag at 0:03→0:02, S094b reads 0:01, S095 holds 0:01 while the front wheel crosses, and WINNER appears only after the horn. The clock never runs backwards (FINAL 1:00 at S075 down to 0:01, with no overlay in the sepia flashback). The S093 close overhead finally shows the robot backing off the barrier it was jammed against and curving round its end, on the same barrier S077 and S086b showed it stuck on. The S066 set-down plays: the bench is in frame and the screwdriver stays on it after the click. S067 has Eli as a back-turned foreground figure while Noah leaves through the EXIT door, so 'didn't notice' now fits the picture. The shout mouths read as yelling (S083/S086/S089/S090), the robot is jammed on the table in S084, S060's caption is clear, S075 starts at 1:00, and S020's face is visible. The problems left are smaller and local, but a first-time viewer will still trip on them. (1) In S054b a giant disembodied red arm slides in from frame-right while both of Eli's arms are visible. Nothing flips: the phone squashes and Eli stares into the lens. (2) The S061→S065 reverse setup contradicts itself. In S061 Eli faces Noah and smiles ('doesn't look up' per the script); in S065, from the same angle, his back is turned, his laptop screen faces away from him and his arms are spread in a shrug. (3) The S102 'shoulder bump' never happens. Noah freezes in a mid-stride scissor pose for about 2.5 s and the hit is 25 px. (4) S091b is still a flat card with no wheel or body edge. (5) S097's trophy is never lifted; the hand floats beside it. (6) The ending blocking hasn't changed: S106 Eli sits out of reach of the keys and S108 is a meditation pose with no piano. New small sense bugs: S009 Eli's leg passes through the desk, and the triumph theme starts early on S091b and then starts a second time on the horn.
strengths: Single, monotonic finish: S094 0:03→0:02 with no flag contact, S094b 0:01, S095 0:01 crossing in slow-mo, scoreboard red→green WINNER on the horn, S096-S102 hold WINNER 0:01. There is no double finish and no 0:02 after 0:01.

Cause→effect chain is complete and geographically consistent. S076 POV at the METAL BARRIER → S077 the robot leaves the route and bumps the lower-middle barrier → S080b/S084/S086b it is still jammed there (now visible on the table in the S084 geography wide) → S091 MAIN→BACKUP switch → S091b blue box ignites → S093 the robot backs off that same barrier and curves round its top end → S092 explanation → S094 resumes from there on a route that clears barrier 3.

Plant/payoff reads: the S059 diagram held up, S060 BACKUP · LEFT with the clear 'METAL CAN CONFUSE IT!' caption, S063 the diagram pushed aside, the S087 sepia restage, S090 LEFT SIDE, the S091b BACKUP · LEFT label, and the S092 overlay naming BACKUP SENSOR · LEFT.

The emotional hinge works. S066: Noah lowers the screwdriver onto an in-frame bench on the click and it stays there. S067: Eli is a blurred, back-turned foreground figure while Noah walks to the EXIT door, which lights and closes on door_close. S068: the empty bench and stool.

The hall exchange has the right emotion. Shout/panic mouths are open arches, so Noah's 'three weeks ago' and 'LEFT SIDE!' read as anger and urgency, not laughter. Screen direction holds: Eli points right in S085, Noah points left in S090, and in S098 Eli walks screen-right toward Noah, who is screen-right in S099.

VO sync is clean. 0 overlaps. Every character line starts on its cut (L061 S083, L062 S084, L063 S085, L064 S086→S086b, L066 S089, L067 S090). L068's 'The robot turned' lands on S093 and 'Missed the barrier' on its end and the S092 GFX. Dropping L069 lets the finish play in heartbeat-only silence.

Continuity holds: dawn bedroom S019-S029, night S041-S044, the TEAM: ELI & NOAH card, the red/blue stripes, the friends' photo S055→S104, Noah in the bleachers in every hall angle, and the S026/S108 callback framing.

v2_followup.note: S094 0:03→0:02, the robot stops ~85 px short of FINISH. S094b 0:01, S095 0:01 crossing, WINNER after the horn.

Close overhead: the robot starts pressed against the lower barrier (glowing red-pink), backs out, and arcs over the barrier's top end with a blue trail. Minor: on the first ~3 frames the wheel overlaps the bar (see issues).
Bench at y 880 in frame. The tool lands on the click at 3.0 s and stays on the bench to the end. It is small and dark but readable.
Open arch and 'o' mouths read as yelling and panic.

S067 is fixed (Eli back-turned FG while Noah exits). S065 now has Eli's back to camera, but the laptop screen faces the camera (away from Eli) and the P.controller pose spreads both arms like a shrug. S061, from the same reverse plate, shows Eli facing Noah and smiling. In S068 Eli still faces the camera: turn .95 renders face-on.
The robot sits jammed on the course table.

The phone's glow dies and a dark back stays. But the 'hand' is a separate bigHand arm, at insert scale, sliding in from frame-right while both of Eli's arms are visible (a third arm). The phone squashes instead of flipping, the notification floats in the air beside it, and Eli stares into the lens instead of at his work.

S020 is fixed: face and eye-rub visible, book beside him. S044: the book no longer sits on his head, but his head slumps in front of and below the desk edge, with the book floating above it. It reads as 'dozed off in the chair', not 'head on the open textbook'.
Stripes, an ignite flash and the BACKUP · LEFT label were added, but it is still a rounded rectangle with no wheel, chassis edge or depth. It reads as a UI tile.
The bigger kid overtakes Eli and carries the ball out of frame. Eli never dribbles at the start (the ball is already ahead of him), but the point reads.
Same diagonal head-down, legs-up freeze for ~1.4 s. The ball moves ~100 px.

The heads no longer touch, but there is no visible bump at all now. Noah's walk phase is computed from displacement, which stops changing after .8 s, so he freezes in a mid-stride scissor pose for the rest of the shot. Eli's 25 px rock is invisible at h 600.
Caption fully readable.
Static trophy, static disembodied arm whose hand stops beside the base. There is no lift. Eli's eyeline change is subtle.
Cube, upright chessboard, book (covering his face) and circuit board still float in front of his chest with his arms spread.
S106: Eli's stool is beyond the piano's end, arms reaching into air. S108: cross-legged, arms out, no keyboard (meditation pose).
Still flat palms with the fingers pointing up at the keys.
S051 Eli smiles at the lens and the cube is pre-placed. S069 lookX glance is too subtle to read on a front-facing CU. S089 timer chip is small.
The route now passes under barrier 3's bottom tip. Clearance in S094 is only ~10 px at 1080p; widen it if cheap.

issues.problem: Visual nonsense at a story beat (Eli ignoring Noah's text). Eli (headAt 700,470, P.hold) has both arms visible, and a separate giant red arm (bigHand at 1500→1260, insert scale) slides in from frame-right at 1.3 s. It reads as a third arm or someone else's arm. The phone stands upright, the notification floats in mid-air to its right, and the 'flip' is a scaleY squash. Eli stares into the lens the whole time, so 'without looking' doesn't come across.
issues.fix: act2.js S054b: remove the bigHand. Drive Eli's own front arm: pose poseAt(c.t,[[0,P.hold()],[1.3,P.hold()],[1.6,{...P.hold(),fa:[20,-10]}]]) so that handF lands on the phone (position the phone at Eli's handF reach, e.g. translate(1020,960)). Keep Eli's head on lookX .3, lookY 1 (down at his book on the desk, add PR.openBook(760,990)). Lay the phone flat (skewX -30, scaleY .45) and draw the bubble ON the screen as a lock-screen card. Flip = scaleX 1→-1 about its long axis with the back face (#1b1820) after the midpoint.

issues.problem: The same reverse workshop plate shows two incompatible Elis. In S061 Eli faces the camera, which is from Noah's side, and smiles at Noah on 'Already fixed it'. The script says he doesn't look up, and it plays as smug. Two shots later, in S065 from the same angle, his back is to the camera. Noah also jumps from FG-left (S061) to FG-right (S065). In S065 the laptop is drawn after Eli with its screen facing the camera, so it faces away from Eli. P.controller spreads both arms out like a shrug, so he isn't 'still typing'.
issues.fix: act3.js S061: use the S065 treatment, A(c,{who:'eli',...,f:-1,front:true,back:true,pose:P.sitType(c.T)}), and keep Noah FG at the same side in both shots (headAt [1650,420] in both, or [260,380] in both). In S065 and S061, draw the laptop BEFORE Eli as a lid-back (dark rect plus a thin glow rim, no codeScreen) so the screen faces Eli, and use pose P.sitType(c.T) (both forearms forward and down) instead of P.controller. The 'turn' param in S061/S068 renders face-on: check rig.js turn handling, or use back:true wherever a back-turned Eli is intended.

issues.problem: The reconciliation's last image doesn't show its action. Noah's walk phase = walkPh(displacement), and the displacement stops changing after k reaches 1 at .8 s. He freezes in a mid-stride scissor pose for ~2.2 s, which reads as a stuck frame. The 'shoulder bump' is a 25 px x-shift of Eli at h 600, invisible, and Noah never makes contact.
issues.fix: act3.js S102: after k≥1, blend Noah to P.stand (mixPose(P.walk(...),P.stand(),atE(c,.8,1.0))). Make the bump a contact: Noah x 1160→ (Eli x + 95), lean +14 into Eli at .8-.95 s, then Eli hit = 60 px with rot -hit*.3 and an outBack recovery over .4 s. Then both get headTilt and bob 4 px at 5 Hz for the laugh.

issues.problem: The cause shot of the payoff is still a flat, rounded UI card: two stripes and a blue square, with no wheel, body edge or depth. For 1 s a first-time viewer doesn't connect it to the robot (S060's real robot has a dark chassis with wheels and the blue box on its left end).
issues.fix: act3.js S091b: draw PR.robot(1100,760,{s:5.5, ledBackup: atE(c,.15,.35)}) and crop so the left wheel (bottom-left) and the chassis corner with the blue box fill the frame, at the same box position and colour as S060's insert. Keep the flash and the BACKUP · LEFT label. Delete the rounded-card rect.

issues.problem: The 'official's hand lifts the trophy' isn't there. The trophy stands still, the navy arm is static and its hand floats beside the base. Eli smiles at the lens before his look-right flip, so 'looks past it toward Noah' only half reads.
issues.fix: act3.js S097: bigHand grip at the stem (600,880), and both trophy and hand y -= 40*atE(c,.1,.7). Eli: turn the head (lookX 1 plus headTilt 6, body f:1 with turn .3) from .6 s and hold it. Use expr 'neutral'→'worried' instead of a smile so the guilt carries into S098.

issues.problem: Eli's front leg passes through the desk top: the knee is above the desk and the shin is drawn across the desk surface. He looks perched on the desk edge rather than seated behind it.
issues.fix: act1.js S009: draw PR.desk after the actor (in the fg layer), or move Eli's seat 120 px behind the desk (y -40, h ×.95) so the legs are hidden by the desk front.

issues.problem: triumph_resolve starts at S091b+.3 (295.2 s), before the robot has cleared the barrier, then stops at S094b and starts again on the horn. The victory theme plays twice, and the first entry tells the viewer the outcome before the finish.
issues.fix: act3.js S091b: replace the triumph_resolve cue with a rising tension sting (e.g. tension_competition at .4 with fade .2, or a riser sfx). The stop on S094b and the triumph on the horn stay as they are.

issues.problem: Still lands head-down with the legs up in a diagonal and freezes ~1.4 s. It looks like a headstand or a stuck frame, not 'flat on his back'.
issues.fix: act1.js S013: final rot -90 with head and hips at the same ground y, a 6-frame bounce plus shake(c.t,8) on landing, a blink and leg twitch at +.6 s, and the ball rolling 300 px toward the goal (E.out).

issues.problem: 'Head on his open textbook' becomes 'slumped in the chair with his head below the desk edge', and the book floats above his head.
issues.fix: act2.js S044: draw PR.openBook at desk-top height under the actor layer, headAt [1000, deskTop-40] with the cheek on the right page, and arms folded on the desk (fa/ba ≈ [80,150]).

issues.problem: S106: Eli's stool is beyond the piano's right end, so he can't be playing with Noah. S108: cross-legged with arms spread and no keyboard in frame, which reads as meditation. The 'seated at the piano' context is lost on the punchline.
issues.fix: act3.js S106: Eli stool x = piano right edge − 40, hands on the keys. S108: {...P.sitPiano(c.T,0)} with the keyboard edge across the bottom FG (as in S107).

issues.problem: Obsession objects float upright in front of his chest (the chessboard like a sign, and a book that hides his face) while his arms spread wide.
issues.fix: act2.js obsession(): rest each object on the desk top, lay the chessboard flat (top trapezoid), and give each object a working pose with the hands on it.

issues.problem: For the first ~3 frames the robot's wheel and chassis overlap the barrier rectangle (pressed into it, not against it). In an overhead this reads as a clip-through.
issues.fix: act3.js S093: offset the start pose so the robot's bounding box ends ≥6 px left of the bar (start x − 30), or draw the barrier after the robot for t < .15 s.

issues.problem: The desc says they carry the robot and the trophy, but the trophy holdSvg is at scale .25 on a 150 px figure (invisible) and there is no robot. The image is just two tiny walkers.
issues.fix: act3.js S103: either drop it from the desc, or give Noah holdSvg PR.robot(0,0,{s:.12}) and Eli PR.trophy(0,0,.6), and push in (cam z 1.25→1.6) so they read.

issues.problem: During the early rounds the scoreboard shows a static ROUND 1/2 1:00 while the robot races and finishes. That is a frozen clock the viewer may read as 'not started'.
issues.fix: act3.js arena(): for S070-S074 pass clock '✓' (ROUND 1 ✓ / ROUND 2 ✓ after S073's finish), or run a round clock that stops on the finish.

issues.problem: With L076 cut, L077 opens with 'And the one thing he needed most...' and the stated moral ('didn't mean he already knew everything') is gone. S103 then has no line to set up the 'teach' that S106 calls back.
issues.fix: Restore L076 over S102's tail/S103 (B38 pre .3), or change L077's read to drop 'And'. Script-level: flag to story_flow.

issues.problem: S069: the 'glance at the empty stool' is lookX on a front-facing CU and doesn't read. S051: Eli smiles at the lens, not up at the student, and the cube is pre-placed. S089: the 'large foreground timer' is a small chip.
issues.fix: S069: add a head turn (turn .35, lookX 1) at .5-1.4 s plus a blurred stool in the right third. S051: lookX 1, lookY -.6, and the cube drops from the student's hand at .2 s. S089: finalTimer size 140 at (1450,880).

issues.problem: Keyboard hands are palm-up with the fingers pointing at the keys, so they don't look like playing or typing.
issues.fix: props bigHand {palmDown:true} variant for the TOP inserts (knuckles to camera, fingertips foreshortened onto the keys).
